script.analysis: All21062characters read in seven contiguous bounded ranges with canonical hash verified. Opens what-if small habits versus lottery/crypto/trustfund, promises100k without sacrifice, selfintro and early subscribe/like. Threshold compounding setup → millionaire appearance/lifestyle inflation → automation → match → debt → emergency reserve → gamification → subscription audit → asset/car digression → duplicated six-win recaps and future-self imperative. Accessible paycheck automation and envelope exercise are practical mechanisms; popcorn/wealth-destruction-with-leather metaphors and aspirational quiet-millionaire identity sustain tone. Ending recaps twice, potentially redundant but retention unknown. No timed30second claim or community promotion. Full available ending complete. Actual income constraint acknowledged only in start5% advice, while deterministic math/proven claims overstate universality.
